description: Unit tests for QuicCoalescedPacket class in QUIC protocol implementation, testing packet coalescing, buffer copying, and initial packet neutering.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: Class representing a coalesced QUIC packet, supporting coalescing, neutering, and buffer copying.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a serialized packet into the current coalesced packet, considering size and address constraints.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies the encrypted buffers from the coalesced packet into a provided buffer.

methods.name: NeuterInitialPacket
methods.description: Resets the coalesced packet to remove the initial packet, resetting relevant state.

methods.name: TransmissionTypeOfPacket
methods.description: Returns the transmission type of the packet with a given encryption level.

methods.name: max_packet_length
methods.description: Returns the maximum packet length of the coalesced packet.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the coalesced packet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the coalesced packet for debugging.
